hero.heading: Build. Learn. Fly.
hero.lead: Aero Makers at Georgia Tech fosters an inclusive, friendly environment where students connect with the broader aerospace community through hands-on projects, workshops, and shared equipment.

welcome.heading: Making aerospace accessible to everyone on campus
welcome.description: AMGT bridges the gap between classroom theory and real engineering. We run events that teach members how to make things and invest in equipment that benefits aerospace maker projects across Georgia Tech.

events.lead: From build nights to fabrication workshops, our events give every student a chance to get hands-on with real aerospace engineering.

hero.heading: Tools that push what GT makers can build
hero.lead: We purchase and maintain equipment that directly supports aerospace maker projects on campus—helping student teams move faster from idea to flight-ready hardware.

hero.heading: Our mission & team
hero.lead: We foster an inclusive, friendly environment between students and the larger aerospace community through hands-on projects, events, and shared equipment.

mission.description: AMGT exists to bridge the gap between classroom theory and real engineering. We run events that teach members how to make things—from composite layups to flight hardware—and we invest in equipment that benefits aerospace maker projects across Georgia Tech.
mission.description2: Whether you're prototyping a drone, machining a bracket, or learning a new fabrication skill for the first time, you'll find a welcoming community ready to help you push the bounds of what can be created.
